sentence: This project builds methods that let care partners teach a robot to help a person with Mild Cognitive Impairment with daily activities.
This project builds computer tools for studying the genomes of giant viruses.
This project gets a supercomputing cluster to run simulations of quantum phenomena in chemicals and materials.
This project studies how to keep data private in decentralized optimization without losing accuracy.
This project builds a framework that uses generative adversarial networks to find malicious activity on networks of medical devices.
This project studies why and how grasslands in low rainfall areas are shifting to shrub and bare ground.
This project builds a remotely accessible lab system for teaching Artificial Intelligence with hands-on hardware.
This project develops materials and a process that double the density of patterns made with existing lithography equipment.
This project builds open-source software that combines machine learning with thermodynamic theory to model phase diagrams of materials.
This project tests whether chromatin remodeling gives activator molecules a delay step that helps them pick the correct genes.
This project studies how zebrafish develop the many types of retinal ganglion cells, the output neurons of the eye.
This project studies how leafflower moths and their host plants shifted from a mutualism to a parasitic relationship.
This project develops a robot teleoperation method based on deep learning and studies gender differences in teleoperating robots.
This project studies how microgravity helps cells organize into vascularized liver tissue.
This project tries to make large visual learning models easier to use by cutting the data, computation and human expertise they need.
This project develops personalized soft sensors made by 3D printing polymers, using machine learning to predict and control the printing.
